definitions.explanation: A tool used to remove pencil marks from paper. Made of rubber or similar material.

examples.japanese: {消|け}しゴムを{使|つか}ってください。
{消|け}しゴムを{貸|か}してください。

examples.english: I'll erase it with an eraser.

notes:
{消|け}しゴム is a tool for erasing pencil marks, part of basic stationery vocabulary.

ETYMOLOGY:
Combines {消|け}す (to erase) + ゴム (rubber, from English 'gum').

COUNTER:
{個|こ} is used: {一|いっ}{個|こ}, {二|に}{個|こ}, etc.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {消|け}しゴムで{消|け}す: to erase with an eraser
- {消|け}しゴムを{使|つか}う: to use an eraser
- {消|け}しゴムを{貸|か}す: to lend an eraser

RELATED WORDS:
- {鉛筆|えんぴつ}: pencil
- {消|け}す: to erase
- {砂|すな}{消|け}し: ink eraser
